title: Going to Rwanda and Burundi
excerpt: A group of us will be joining a group of emerging African leaders associated with amahoro-africa.com in Rwanda and Burundi in a few weeks. Here’s a beautiful video/song from Sara Groves about Rwanda – it matches my experiences in Africa perfectly.
body:
A group of us will be joining a group of emerging African leaders associated with amahoro-africa.com in Rwanda and Burundi in a few weeks.

Here’s a beautiful video/song from Sara Groves about Rwanda – it matches my experiences in Africa perfectly.
